image_location_description: Lower third (legs), from boots up to belt line

steps.title: Lay out feet
steps.description: Place 2x white 1x2 plates side-by-side as boots.

steps.title: Build lower legs
steps.description: Add 2x white 1x2 bricks on top of the boot plates.

steps.title: Add knee markings
steps.description: Stack 2x tan 1x2 plates on the lower-leg bricks.

steps.title: Build upper legs
steps.description: Add 2x white 1x2 bricks on top to form thighs.

steps.title: Add thigh markings
steps.description: Stack 2x tan 1x2 plates on top for subtle upper pattern.

steps.title: Cap at belt line
steps.description: Bridge both legs with 1x white 2x2 plate as the hip top.

steps.title: Dark tan accent
steps.description: Add 1x dark tan 1x1 piece on front of the hip plate.
